subject.why: The canteen is immediately recognisable with its round body, metal cap, looping strap, and central sunflower patch.

category.why: The object floats cleanly in three-quarter view without ground or surface, set against radiating sunburst rays as requested for Category 1.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, borders, or characters.

framing.why: Centered with a chunky silhouette and generous margins on all four sides.

colour.why: Vibrant and warm palette with high contrast between the red canteen and the sunny yellow ray background.

detail.why: Clean, simplified forms without busy micro-textures or excessive small elements.

style.why: Smooth, chunky 3D volumes with a soft satin sheen that matches the reference style.

bg_colour.why: background is yellow (78% of the background); planned yellow
